context_title:
1. `resolveApiUrl()` always appends `/v1/chat/completions` to `ENV.forgeApiUrl`, so a configured base that already contains `/v1` or an endpoint path produces malformed URLs such as duplicated path segments.

2. `listLLMModels*()` repeats the same URL-concatenation bug by always appending `/v1/models` to the configured base string without normalizing whether `/v1` is already present.

3. `ENV*` is initialized from environment variables at module import time, so later environment changes are ignored unless outside code mutates the exported global manually.

4. `ENV*` is exported as a mutable global, which makes request behavior depend on shared mutable state instead of explicit function inputs and creates order-dependent behavior across callers.

5. `assertApiKey()` trims whitespace when validating the API key, but the `Authorization` header is built from `ENV.forgeApiKey` without trimming, so keys with leading or trailing whitespace pass validation and still fail at request time.

6. `Message*` has no `tool_calls` field even though `ChoiceMessage*` does, so assistant tool-call responses cannot be round-tripped through the typed request model.

7. `normalizeMessage()` has no path that can serialize assistant `tool_calls`, so the library cannot faithfully send prior assistant tool-call turns back to the API in a follow-up request.

8. `Role*` is just a `string`, and no validation restricts it to supported role names, so invalid roles are accepted locally and only fail later at the API boundary.

9. `normalizeMessage()` allows `tool_call_id` on any role because it never validates role-specific field usage, so structurally invalid messages can be emitted.

10. `normalizeMessage()` also allows `name` on any role without validating whether that role supports it, so the client can generate impossible or provider-rejected message shapes.

11. `ensureArray()` coerces any non-array, non-null `JsonNode` into a one-element sequence, which hides caller mistakes by silently treating arbitrary JSON as message content parts.

12. `normalizeContentPart()` accepts any object whose `"type"` is `"text"`, `"image_url"`, or `"file_url"` without validating the required payload fields for that content type.

13. Because of that weak validation, a `"text"` content object can pass through without a valid `"text"` string and later be dereferenced by `normalizeMessage()` as if it were valid.

14. The same weak validation allows malformed `"image_url"` and `"file_url"` objects to be forwarded directly into outbound requests instead of being rejected locally.

15. When non-tool message content is `nil` or `JNull`, `normalizeMessage()` turns it into an empty JSON array instead of rejecting missing content or emitting a clear null representation, which produces an ambiguous request payload.

16. For `"tool"` and `"function"` role messages, `normalizeMessage()` flattens all parts into a newline-joined string, so structured tool output cannot be preserved faithfully.

17. In that same tool/function path, non-string parts are stringified with `$part`, which converts JSON into Nim-rendered text and can alter exact formatting and content representation.

18. `normalizeToolChoice()` implements `"required"` by raising when more than one tool is configured, which incorrectly narrows standard tool-choice semantics from “must call a tool” to “must call this single tool.”

19. `normalizeToolChoice()` accepts arbitrary string values other than `"none"`, `"auto"`, and `"required"` and returns them unchanged, so invalid `tool_choice` strings are passed through instead of rejected.

20. `normalizeToolChoice()` rewrites `{ "name": ... }` into a function selector without checking whether that tool name actually exists in the configured tool list.

21. `normalizeToolChoice()` also returns most object values unchanged without validating their schema, so malformed tool-choice objects can be emitted directly into the request payload.

22. `invokeLLM*()` allows requests with no `model` field at all because it only serializes `model` when `params.model.isSome`, and it never performs local validation that a model was provided.

23. `invokeLLM*()` also accepts `some("")` as the model name and forwards it unchanged, so an obviously invalid empty model identifier is not rejected locally.

24. The precedence rules for duplicated camelCase and snake_case inputs are inconsistent: `toolChoice`, `responseFormat`, and `outputSchema` prefer camelCase, while `max_tokens` prefers snake_case, so equivalent caller inputs can yield different payloads depending on naming style.

25. The code never rejects contradictory duplicated inputs such as both `toolChoice` and `tool_choice` being set differently, so silent precedence decides behavior instead of validation.

26. `normalizeResponseFormat()` only partially validates explicit `json_schema` response formats because it checks for `json_schema.schema` but does not require a non-empty `json_schema.name` on that path.

27. `normalizeResponseFormat()` accepts `outputSchema.schema` when it is either a JSON object or a JSON array, even though a top-level JSON Schema should be an object, so invalid schemas can pass local validation.

28. Tool definitions are serialized without validating `t.type`, `t.function.name`, or the shape of `t.function.parameters`, so malformed tool specs are forwarded directly to the API.

29. `invokeLLM*()` sends both `thinking` and `reasoning` if both are present, with no conflict handling or provider-capability check, so mutually unsupported fields can be emitted together.

30. `fetchWithBackoff()` retries every non-2xx HTTP response indiscriminately, including deterministic client errors such as bad requests and authentication failures, which wastes time and obscures root causes.

31. `fetchWithBackoff()` applies the same retry behavior to `POST` requests as to safe reads, so ambiguous transport failures can cause the same side-effecting operation to be submitted more than once.

32. `computeBackoffDelay()` clamps even server-supplied `Retry-After` values to `RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS`, so the client can knowingly violate a longer backoff requested by the server.

33. `fetchWithBackoff()` creates a fresh `AsyncHttpClient` for every retry attempt instead of reusing one, which prevents connection reuse and adds unnecessary overhead.

34. `fetchWithBackoff()` always reads the full response body before deciding whether to retry, which is unnecessary for many retry decisions and increases failure-path cost.

35. `toInvokeResult()` parses server responses permissively with default empty strings and zeros through `getOrDefault(...).getStr()/getInt()/getBiggestInt()`, so malformed or incomplete responses are silently converted into plausible-looking data instead of being rejected.

36. `listLLMModels*()` repeats the same permissive parsing pattern, which can produce model entries with blank IDs or zero timestamps instead of surfacing provider schema errors.

37. `toInvokeResult()` silently ignores malformed or non-array `tool_calls` instead of rejecting the response shape, which turns protocol drift into partial data loss.

38. The typed helper types like `TextContent*`, `ImageContent*`, `FileContent*`, and `JsonSchema*` are largely bypassed in favor of raw `JsonNode` handling, so the API surface looks strongly typed while the implementation performs only partial runtime validation.

39. The module ends with an unconditional top-level `randomize()`, which is an import-time side effect that mutates process-global RNG state simply by loading the module.

40. Because retry jitter uses the global RNG, that import-time `randomize()` also makes retry timing nondeterministic in tests unless callers explicitly reseed the global generator afterward.

import std/[asyncdispatch, httpclient, httpcore, json, math, os, options, random, strutils, times]

type
  Env* = object
    forgeApiUrl*: string
    forgeApiKey*: string

var ENV* = Env(
  forgeApiUrl: if getEnv("FORGE_API_URL").len > 0: getEnv("FORGE_API_URL") else: getEnv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
  forgeApiKey: if getEnv("FORGE_API_KEY").len > 0: getEnv("FORGE_API_KEY") else: getEnv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
)

type
  Role* = string

  TextContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    text*: string

  ImageUrl* = object
    url*: string
    detail*: Option[string]

  ImageContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    image_url*: ImageUrl

  FileUrl* = object
    url*: string
    mime_type*: Option[string]

  FileContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    file_url*: FileUrl

  Message* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: JsonNode
    name*: Option[string]
    tool_call_id*: Option[string]

  ToolFunction* = object
    name*: string
    description*: Option[string]
    parameters*: Option[JsonNode]

  Tool* = object
    `type`*: string
    function*: ToolFunction

  ToolCallFunction* = object
    name*: string
    arguments*: string

  ToolCall* = object
    id*: string
    `type`*: string
    function*: ToolCallFunction

  UsageInfo* = object
    prompt_tokens*: int
    completion_tokens*: int
    total_tokens*: int

  ChoiceMessage* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: JsonNode
    tool_calls*: Option[seq[ToolCall]]

  Choice* = object
    index*: int
    message*: ChoiceMessage
    finish_reason*: Option[string]

  InvokeResult* = object
    id*: string
    created*: int64
    model*: string
    choices*: seq[Choice]
    usage*: Option[UsageInfo]

  JsonSchema* = object
    name*: string
    schema*: JsonNode
    strict*: Option[bool]

  OutputSchema* = JsonSchema

  InvokeParams* = object
    messages*: seq[Message]
    tools*: Option[seq[Tool]]
    toolChoice*: Option[JsonNode]
    tool_choice*: Option[JsonNode]
    maxTokens*: Option[int]
    max_tokens*: Option[int]
    outputSchema*: Option[JsonNode]
    output_schema*: Option[JsonNode]
    responseFormat*: Option[JsonNode]
    response_format*: Option[JsonNode]
    model*: Option[string]
    thinking*: Option[JsonNode]
    reasoning*: Option[JsonNode]

  ModelInfo* = object
    id*: string
    `object`*: string
    created*: int64
    owned_by*: string

  ModelsResponse* = object
    `object`*: string
    data*: seq[ModelInfo]

  HttpResponse = object
    status: HttpCode
    headers: HttpHeaders
    body: string

const
  RETRY_MAX_RETRIES = 4
  RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS = 500
  RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS = 30_000

proc initMessage*(role: Role, content: string, name: Option[string] = none(string), toolCallId: Option[string] = none(string)): Message =
  Message(role: role, content: %content, name: name, tool_call_id: toolCallId)

proc initMessage*(role: Role, content: JsonNode, name: Option[string] = none(string), toolCallId: Option[string] = none(string)): Message =
  Message(role: role, content: content, name: name, tool_call_id: toolCallId)

proc ensureArray(value: JsonNode): seq[JsonNode] =
  if value == nil or value.kind == JNull:
    return @[]
  if value.kind == JArray:
    for item in value:
      result.add(item)
  else:
    result.add(value)

proc normalizeContentPart(part: JsonNode): JsonNode =
  if part.kind == JString:
    return %*{"type": "text", "text": part.getStr()}

  if part.kind == JObject and part.hasKey("type"):
    let t = part["type"].getStr()
    if t in ["text", "image_url", "file_url"]:
      return part

  raise newException(ValueError, "Unsupported message content part")

proc normalizeMessage(message: Message): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["role"] = %message.role

  if message.name.isSome:
    result["name"] = %message.name.get()

  if message.tool_call_id.isSome:
    result["tool_call_id"] = %message.tool_call_id.get()

  let parts = ensureArray(message.content)

  if message.role in ["tool", "function"]:
    var strParts: seq[string] = @[]
    for part in parts:
      if part.kind == JString:
        strParts.add(part.getStr())
      else:
        strParts.add($part)
    result["content"] = %strParts.join("\n")
    return

  var contentParts: seq[JsonNode] = @[]
  for part in parts:
    contentParts.add(normalizeContentPart(part))

  if contentParts.len == 1 and contentParts[0].hasKey("type") and contentParts[0]["type"].getStr() == "text":
    result["content"] = %contentParts[0]["text"].getStr()
  else:
    var arr = newJArray()
    for cp in contentParts:
      arr.add(cp)
    result["content"] = arr

proc normalizeToolChoice(toolChoice: Option[JsonNode], tools: Option[seq[Tool]]): JsonNode =
  if toolChoice.isNone or toolChoice.get() == nil or toolChoice.get().kind == JNull:
    return nil

  let tc = toolChoice.get()

  if tc.kind == JString:
    let val = tc.getStr()
    if val in ["none", "auto"]:
      return %val
    if val == "required":
      let toolsSeq = if tools.isSome: tools.get() else: @[]
      if toolsSeq.len == 0:
        raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' was provided but no tools were configured")
      if toolsSeq.len > 1:
        raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' needs a single tool or specify the tool name explicitly")
      return %*{"type": "function", "function": {"name": toolsSeq[0].function.name}}

  if tc.kind == JObject:
    if tc.hasKey("name"):
      return %*{"type": "function", "function": {"name": tc["name"].getStr()}}
    return tc

  return tc

proc resolveApiUrl(): string =
  let raw = ENV.forgeApiUrl.strip()
  if raw.len > 0:
    raw.strip(chars = {'/'}, leading = false) & "/v1/chat/completions"
  else:
    ""

proc assertApiKey() =
  if ENV.forgeApiKey.strip().len == 0:
    raise newException(ValueError, "forgeApiKey is not configured")

proc normalizeResponseFormat(
    responseFormat: Option[JsonNode],
    response_format: Option[JsonNode],
    outputSchema: Option[JsonNode],
    output_schema: Option[JsonNode]
): JsonNode =
  let explicitFormat = if responseFormat.isSome: responseFormat else: response_format
  if explicitFormat.isSome and explicitFormat.get() != nil and explicitFormat.get().kind != JNull:
    let ef = explicitFormat.get()
    if ef.kind == JObject and ef.hasKey("type") and ef["type"].getStr() == "json_schema":
      if not ef.hasKey("json_schema") or ef["json_schema"].kind != JObject or not ef["json_schema"].hasKey("schema") or ef["json_schema"]["schema"].kind == JNull:
        raise newException(ValueError, "responseFormat json_schema requires a defined schema object")
    return ef

  let schemaOpt = if outputSchema.isSome: outputSchema else: output_schema
  if schemaOpt.isNone or schemaOpt.get() == nil or schemaOpt.get().kind == JNull:
    return nil

  let schema = schemaOpt.get()
  if not schema.hasKey("name") or schema["name"].kind != JString or schema["name"].getStr().len == 0 or not schema.hasKey("schema") or schema["schema"].kind notin {JObject, JArray}:
    raise newException(ValueError, "outputSchema requires both name and schema")

  var jsonSchemaObj = newJObject()
  jsonSchemaObj["name"] = schema["name"]
  jsonSchemaObj["schema"] = schema["schema"]
  if schema.hasKey("strict") and schema["strict"].kind == JBool:
    jsonSchemaObj["strict"] = schema["strict"]

  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"json_schema"
  result["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaObj

proc parseRetryAfter(value: string): Option[int] =
  let trimmed = value.strip()
  if trimmed.len == 0:
    return none(int)
  try:
    let seconds = parseFloat(trimmed)
    if seconds >= 0.0 and seconds < 100000000.0:
      return some(int(seconds * 1000.0))
  except ValueError:
    discard
  for fmt in ["ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", "ddd, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"]:
    try:
      let dt = parse(trimmed, fmt, utc())
      let diff = int((dt.toTime() - getTime()).inMilliseconds)
      return some(max(0, diff))
    except CatchableError:
      discard
  return none(int)

proc computeBackoffDelay(attempt: int, retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)): int =
  let cap = min(float(RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS * (1 shl attempt)), float(RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS))
  let jittered = cap / 2.0 + rand(cap / 2.0)
  let target = if retryAfterMs.isSome: max(jittered, float(retryAfterMs.get())) else: jittered
  result = int(min(target, float(RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS)))

proc isOk(code: HttpCode): bool =
  code.int in 200 .. 299

proc fetchWithBackoff(
    url: string,
    httpMethod: HttpMethod,
    headers: HttpHeaders,
    body: string
): Future[HttpResponse] {.async.} =
  var lastException: ref CatchableError = nil

  for attempt in 0 .. RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
    let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
    try:
      let resp = await client.request(url, httpMethod = $httpMethod, body = body, headers = headers)
      let statusCode = resp.code
      let respBody = await resp.body
      try:
        client.close()
      except CatchableError:
        discard

      if isOk(statusCode) or attempt == RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
        return HttpResponse(status: statusCode, headers: resp.headers, body: respBody)

      var retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)
      if resp.headers.hasKey("retry-after"):
        retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(resp.headers["retry-after"])

      await sleepAsync(computeBackoffDelay(attempt, retryAfterMs))
    except CatchableError as e:
      try:
        client.close()
      except CatchableError:
        discard
      lastException = e
      if attempt == RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
        raise e
      await sleepAsync(computeBackoffDelay(attempt))

  if lastException != nil:
    raise lastException
  else:
    raise newException(IOError, "LLM request failed after exhausting retries")

proc toInvokeResult(node: JsonNode): InvokeResult =
  result.id = node.getOrDefault("id").getStr()
  result.created = node.getOrDefault("created").getBiggestInt()
  result.model = node.getOrDefault("model").getStr()
  result.choices = @[]

  if node.hasKey("choices") and node["choices"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["choices"]:
      var choice: Choice
      choice.index = item.getOrDefault("index").getInt()
      if item.hasKey("finish_reason") and item["finish_reason"].kind == JString:
        choice.finish_reason = some(item["finish_reason"].getStr())
      choice.message.content = newJNull()
      if item.hasKey("message") and item["message"].kind == JObject:
        let msgNode = item["message"]
        choice.message.role = msgNode.getOrDefault("role").getStr()
        if msgNode.hasKey("content"):
          choice.message.content = msgNode["content"]
        if msgNode.hasKey("tool_calls") and msgNode["tool_calls"].kind == JArray:
          var calls: seq[ToolCall] = @[]
          for tcNode in msgNode["tool_calls"]:
            var tc: ToolCall
            tc.id = tcNode.getOrDefault("id").getStr()
            tc.`type` = tcNode.getOrDefault("type").getStr("function")
            if tcNode.hasKey("function") and tcNode["function"].kind == JObject:
              tc.function.name = tcNode["function"].getOrDefault("name").getStr()
              tc.function.arguments = tcNode["function"].getOrDefault("arguments").getStr()
            calls.add(tc)
          choice.message.tool_calls = some(calls)
      result.choices.add(choice)

  if node.hasKey("usage") and node["usage"].kind == JObject:
    let u = node["usage"]
    result.usage = some(UsageInfo(
      prompt_tokens: u.getOrDefault("prompt_tokens").getInt(),
      completion_tokens: u.getOrDefault("completion_tokens").getInt(),
      total_tokens: u.getOrDefault("total_tokens").getInt()
    ))

proc invokeLLM*(params: InvokeParams): Future[InvokeResult] {.async.} =
  assertApiKey()

  var payload = newJObject()

  var messagesArr = newJArray()
  for msg in params.messages:
    messagesArr.add(normalizeMessage(msg))
  payload["messages"] = messagesArr

  if params.model.isSome:
    payload["model"] = %params.model.get()

  if params.tools.isSome and params.tools.get().len > 0:
    var toolsArr = newJArray()
    for t in params.tools.get():
      var tObj = %*{"type": t.`type`}
      var fnObj = %*{"name": t.function.name}
      if t.function.description.isSome:
        fnObj["description"] = %t.function.description.get()
      if t.function.parameters.isSome and t.function.parameters.get() != nil:
        fnObj["parameters"] = t.function.parameters.get()
      tObj["function"] = fnObj
      toolsArr.add(tObj)
    payload["tools"] = toolsArr

  let tc = if params.toolChoice.isSome: params.toolChoice else: params.tool_choice
  let normalizedToolChoice = normalizeToolChoice(tc, params.tools)
  if normalizedToolChoice != nil:
    payload["tool_choice"] = normalizedToolChoice

  let resolvedMaxTokens = if params.max_tokens.isSome: params.max_tokens else: params.maxTokens
  if resolvedMaxTokens.isSome:
    payload["max_tokens"] = %resolvedMaxTokens.get()

  if params.thinking.isSome and params.thinking.get() != nil:
    payload["thinking"] = params.thinking.get()

  if params.reasoning.isSome and params.reasoning.get() != nil:
    payload["reasoning"] = params.reasoning.get()

  let normalizedResponseFormat = normalizeResponseFormat(
    params.responseFormat,
    params.response_format,
    params.outputSchema,
    params.output_schema
  )
  if normalizedResponseFormat != nil:
    payload["response_format"] = normalizedResponseFormat

  let headers = newHttpHeaders({
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "authorization": "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey
  })

  let response = await fetchWithBackoff(resolveApiUrl(), HttpPost, headers, $payload)

  if not isOk(response.status):
    raise newException(IOError, "LLM invoke failed: " & $response.status & " – " & response.body)

  let jsonResult = parseJson(response.body)
  result = toInvokeResult(jsonResult)

proc listLLMModels*(): Future[ModelsResponse] {.async.} =
  assertApiKey()

  let url =
    let raw = ENV.forgeApiUrl.strip()
    if raw.len > 0:
      raw.strip(chars = {'/'}, leading = false) & "/v1/models"
    else:
      ""

  let headers = newHttpHeaders({
    "authorization": "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey
  })

  let response = await fetchWithBackoff(url, HttpGet, headers, "")

  if not isOk(response.status):
    raise newException(IOError, "List LLM models failed: " & $response.status & " – " & response.body)

  let jsonResult = parseJson(response.body)
  result.`object` = jsonResult.getOrDefault("object").getStr()
  result.data = @[]

  if jsonResult.hasKey("data") and jsonResult["data"].kind == JArray:
    for item in jsonResult["data"]:
      result.data.add(ModelInfo(
        id: item.getOrDefault("id").getStr(),
        `object`: item.getOrDefault("object").getStr(),
        created: item.getOrDefault("created").getBiggestInt(),
        owned_by: item.getOrDefault("owned_by").getStr()
      ))

import std/[asyncdispatch, httpclient, httpcore, json, math, os, options, random, strutils, times]

type
  Env* = object
    forgeApiUrl*: string
    forgeApiKey*: string

var ENV* = Env(
  forgeApiUrl: if getEnv("FORGE_API_URL").len > 0: getEnv("FORGE_API_URL") else: getEnv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
  forgeApiKey: if getEnv("FORGE_API_KEY").len > 0: getEnv("FORGE_API_KEY") else: getEnv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
)

type
  Role* = string

  TextContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    text*: string

  ImageUrl* = object
    url*: string
    detail*: Option[string]

  ImageContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    image_url*: ImageUrl

  FileUrl* = object
    url*: string
    mime_type*: Option[string]

  FileContent* = object
    `type`*: string
    file_url*: FileUrl

  Message* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: JsonNode
    name*: Option[string]
    tool_call_id*: Option[string]

  ToolFunction* = object
    name*: string
    description*: Option[string]
    parameters*: Option[JsonNode]

  Tool* = object
    `type`*: string
    function*: ToolFunction

  ToolCallFunction* = object
    name*: string
    arguments*: string

  ToolCall* = object
    id*: string
    `type`*: string
    function*: ToolCallFunction

  UsageInfo* = object
    prompt_tokens*: int
    completion_tokens*: int
    total_tokens*: int

  ChoiceMessage* = object
    role*: Role
    content*: JsonNode
    tool_calls*: Option[seq[ToolCall]]

  Choice* = object
    index*: int
    message*: ChoiceMessage
    finish_reason*: Option[string]

  InvokeResult* = object
    id*: string
    created*: int64
    model*: string
    choices*: seq[Choice]
    usage*: Option[UsageInfo]

  JsonSchema* = object
    name*: string
    schema*: JsonNode
    strict*: Option[bool]

  OutputSchema* = JsonSchema

  InvokeParams* = object
    messages*: seq[Message]
    tools*: Option[seq[Tool]]
    toolChoice*: Option[JsonNode]
    tool_choice*: Option[JsonNode]
    maxTokens*: Option[int]
    max_tokens*: Option[int]
    outputSchema*: Option[JsonNode]
    output_schema*: Option[JsonNode]
    responseFormat*: Option[JsonNode]
    response_format*: Option[JsonNode]
    model*: Option[string]
    thinking*: Option[JsonNode]
    reasoning*: Option[JsonNode]

  ModelInfo* = object
    id*: string
    `object`*: string
    created*: int64
    owned_by*: string

  ModelsResponse* = object
    `object`*: string
    data*: seq[ModelInfo]

  HttpResponse = object
    status: HttpCode
    headers: HttpHeaders
    body: string

const
  RETRY_MAX_RETRIES = 4
  RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS = 500
  RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS = 30_000

proc initMessage*(role: Role, content: string, name: Option[string] = none(string), toolCallId: Option[string] = none(string)): Message =
  Message(role: role, content: %content, name: name, tool_call_id: toolCallId)

proc initMessage*(role: Role, content: JsonNode, name: Option[string] = none(string), toolCallId: Option[string] = none(string)): Message =
  Message(role: role, content: content, name: name, tool_call_id: toolCallId)

proc ensureArray(value: JsonNode): seq[JsonNode] =
  if value == nil or value.kind == JNull:
    return @[]
  if value.kind == JArray:
    for item in value:
      result.add(item)
  else:
    result.add(value)

proc normalizeContentPart(part: JsonNode): JsonNode =
  if part.kind == JString:
    return %*{"type": "text", "text": part.getStr()}

  if part.kind == JObject and part.hasKey("type"):
    let t = part["type"].getStr()
    if t in ["text", "image_url", "file_url"]:
      return part

  raise newException(ValueError, "Unsupported message content part")

proc normalizeMessage(message: Message): JsonNode =
  result = newJObject()
  result["role"] = %message.role

  if message.name.isSome:
    result["name"] = %message.name.get()

  if message.tool_call_id.isSome:
    result["tool_call_id"] = %message.tool_call_id.get()

  let parts = ensureArray(message.content)

  if message.role in ["tool", "function"]:
    var strParts: seq[string] = @[]
    for part in parts:
      if part.kind == JString:
        strParts.add(part.getStr())
      else:
        strParts.add($part)
    result["content"] = %strParts.join("\n")
    return

  var contentParts: seq[JsonNode] = @[]
  for part in parts:
    contentParts.add(normalizeContentPart(part))

  if contentParts.len == 1 and contentParts[0].hasKey("type") and contentParts[0]["type"].getStr() == "text":
    result["content"] = %contentParts[0]["text"].getStr()
  else:
    var arr = newJArray()
    for cp in contentParts:
      arr.add(cp)
    result["content"] = arr

proc normalizeToolChoice(toolChoice: Option[JsonNode], tools: Option[seq[Tool]]): JsonNode =
  if toolChoice.isNone or toolChoice.get() == nil or toolChoice.get().kind == JNull:
    return nil

  let tc = toolChoice.get()

  if tc.kind == JString:
    let val = tc.getStr()
    if val in ["none", "auto"]:
      return %val
    if val == "required":
      let toolsSeq = if tools.isSome: tools.get() else: @[]
      if toolsSeq.len == 0:
        raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' was provided but no tools were configured")
      if toolsSeq.len > 1:
        raise newException(ValueError, "tool_choice 'required' needs a single tool or specify the tool name explicitly")
      return %*{"type": "function", "function": {"name": toolsSeq[0].function.name}}

  if tc.kind == JObject:
    if tc.hasKey("name"):
      return %*{"type": "function", "function": {"name": tc["name"].getStr()}}
    return tc

  return tc

proc resolveApiUrl(): string =
  let raw = ENV.forgeApiUrl.strip()
  if raw.len > 0:
    raw.strip(chars = {'/'}, leading = false) & "/v1/chat/completions"
  else:
    ""

proc assertApiKey() =
  if ENV.forgeApiKey.strip().len == 0:
    raise newException(ValueError, "forgeApiKey is not configured")

proc normalizeResponseFormat(
    responseFormat: Option[JsonNode],
    response_format: Option[JsonNode],
    outputSchema: Option[JsonNode],
    output_schema: Option[JsonNode]
): JsonNode =
  let explicitFormat = if responseFormat.isSome: responseFormat else: response_format
  if explicitFormat.isSome and explicitFormat.get() != nil and explicitFormat.get().kind != JNull:
    let ef = explicitFormat.get()
    if ef.kind == JObject and ef.hasKey("type") and ef["type"].getStr() == "json_schema":
      if not ef.hasKey("json_schema") or ef["json_schema"].kind != JObject or not ef["json_schema"].hasKey("schema") or ef["json_schema"]["schema"].kind == JNull:
        raise newException(ValueError, "responseFormat json_schema requires a defined schema object")
    return ef

  let schemaOpt = if outputSchema.isSome: outputSchema else: output_schema
  if schemaOpt.isNone or schemaOpt.get() == nil or schemaOpt.get().kind == JNull:
    return nil

  let schema = schemaOpt.get()
  if not schema.hasKey("name") or schema["name"].kind != JString or schema["name"].getStr().len == 0 or not schema.hasKey("schema") or schema["schema"].kind notin {JObject, JArray}:
    raise newException(ValueError, "outputSchema requires both name and schema")

  var jsonSchemaObj = newJObject()
  jsonSchemaObj["name"] = schema["name"]
  jsonSchemaObj["schema"] = schema["schema"]
  if schema.hasKey("strict") and schema["strict"].kind == JBool:
    jsonSchemaObj["strict"] = schema["strict"]

  result = newJObject()
  result["type"] = %"json_schema"
  result["json_schema"] = jsonSchemaObj

proc parseRetryAfter(value: string): Option[int] =
  let trimmed = value.strip()
  if trimmed.len == 0:
    return none(int)
  try:
    let seconds = parseFloat(trimmed)
    if seconds >= 0.0 and seconds < 100000000.0:
      return some(int(seconds * 1000.0))
  except ValueError:
    discard
  for fmt in ["ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", "ddd, d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss 'GMT'", "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"]:
    try:
      let dt = parse(trimmed, fmt, utc())
      let diff = int((dt.toTime() - getTime()).inMilliseconds)
      return some(max(0, diff))
    except CatchableError:
      discard
  return none(int)

proc computeBackoffDelay(attempt: int, retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)): int =
  let cap = min(float(RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS * (1 shl attempt)), float(RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS))
  let jittered = cap / 2.0 + rand(cap / 2.0)
  let target = if retryAfterMs.isSome: max(jittered, float(retryAfterMs.get())) else: jittered
  result = int(min(target, float(RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS)))

proc isOk(code: HttpCode): bool =
  code.int in 200 .. 299

proc fetchWithBackoff(
    url: string,
    httpMethod: HttpMethod,
    headers: HttpHeaders,
    body: string
): Future[HttpResponse] {.async.} =
  var lastException: ref CatchableError = nil

  for attempt in 0 .. RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
    let client = newAsyncHttpClient()
    try:
      let resp = await client.request(url, httpMethod = $httpMethod, body = body, headers = headers)
      let statusCode = resp.code
      let respBody = await resp.body
      try:
        client.close()
      except CatchableError:
        discard

      if isOk(statusCode) or attempt == RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
        return HttpResponse(status: statusCode, headers: resp.headers, body: respBody)

      var retryAfterMs: Option[int] = none(int)
      if resp.headers.hasKey("retry-after"):
        retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(resp.headers["retry-after"])

      await sleepAsync(computeBackoffDelay(attempt, retryAfterMs))
    except CatchableError as e:
      try:
        client.close()
      except CatchableError:
        discard
      lastException = e
      if attempt == RETRY_MAX_RETRIES:
        raise e
      await sleepAsync(computeBackoffDelay(attempt))

  if lastException != nil:
    raise lastException
  else:
    raise newException(IOError, "LLM request failed after exhausting retries")

proc toInvokeResult(node: JsonNode): InvokeResult =
  result.id = node.getOrDefault("id").getStr()
  result.created = node.getOrDefault("created").getBiggestInt()
  result.model = node.getOrDefault("model").getStr()
  result.choices = @[]

  if node.hasKey("choices") and node["choices"].kind == JArray:
    for item in node["choices"]:
      var choice: Choice
      choice.index = item.getOrDefault("index").getInt()
      if item.hasKey("finish_reason") and item["finish_reason"].kind == JString:
        choice.finish_reason = some(item["finish_reason"].getStr())
      choice.message.content = newJNull()
      if item.hasKey("message") and item["message"].kind == JObject:
        let msgNode = item["message"]
        choice.message.role = msgNode.getOrDefault("role").getStr()
        if msgNode.hasKey("content"):
          choice.message.content = msgNode["content"]
        if msgNode.hasKey("tool_calls") and msgNode["tool_calls"].kind == JArray:
          var calls: seq[ToolCall] = @[]
          for tcNode in msgNode["tool_calls"]:
            var tc: ToolCall
            tc.id = tcNode.getOrDefault("id").getStr()
            tc.`type` = tcNode.getOrDefault("type").getStr("function")
            if tcNode.hasKey("function") and tcNode["function"].kind == JObject:
              tc.function.name = tcNode["function"].getOrDefault("name").getStr()
              tc.function.arguments = tcNode["function"].getOrDefault("arguments").getStr()
            calls.add(tc)
          choice.message.tool_calls = some(calls)
      result.choices.add(choice)

  if node.hasKey("usage") and node["usage"].kind == JObject:
    let u = node["usage"]
    result.usage = some(UsageInfo(
      prompt_tokens: u.getOrDefault("prompt_tokens").getInt(),
      completion_tokens: u.getOrDefault("completion_tokens").getInt(),
      total_tokens: u.getOrDefault("total_tokens").getInt()
    ))

proc invokeLLM*(params: InvokeParams): Future[InvokeResult] {.async.} =
  assertApiKey()

  var payload = newJObject()

  var messagesArr = newJArray()
  for msg in params.messages:
    messagesArr.add(normalizeMessage(msg))
  payload["messages"] = messagesArr

  if params.model.isSome:
    payload["model"] = %params.model.get()

  if params.tools.isSome and params.tools.get().len > 0:
    var toolsArr = newJArray()
    for t in params.tools.get():
      var tObj = %*{"type": t.`type`}
      var fnObj = %*{"name": t.function.name}
      if t.function.description.isSome:
        fnObj["description"] = %t.function.description.get()
      if t.function.parameters.isSome and t.function.parameters.get() != nil:
        fnObj["parameters"] = t.function.parameters.get()
      tObj["function"] = fnObj
      toolsArr.add(tObj)
    payload["tools"] = toolsArr

  let tc = if params.toolChoice.isSome: params.toolChoice else: params.tool_choice
  let normalizedToolChoice = normalizeToolChoice(tc, params.tools)
  if normalizedToolChoice != nil:
    payload["tool_choice"] = normalizedToolChoice

  let resolvedMaxTokens = if params.max_tokens.isSome: params.max_tokens else: params.maxTokens
  if resolvedMaxTokens.isSome:
    payload["max_tokens"] = %resolvedMaxTokens.get()

  if params.thinking.isSome and params.thinking.get() != nil:
    payload["thinking"] = params.thinking.get()

  if params.reasoning.isSome and params.reasoning.get() != nil:
    payload["reasoning"] = params.reasoning.get()

  let normalizedResponseFormat = normalizeResponseFormat(
    params.responseFormat,
    params.response_format,
    params.outputSchema,
    params.output_schema
  )
  if normalizedResponseFormat != nil:
    payload["response_format"] = normalizedResponseFormat

  let headers = newHttpHeaders({
    "content-type": "application/json",
    "authorization": "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey
  })

  let response = await fetchWithBackoff(resolveApiUrl(), HttpPost, headers, $payload)

  if not isOk(response.status):
    raise newException(IOError, "LLM invoke failed: " & $response.status & " – " & response.body)

  let jsonResult = parseJson(response.body)
  result = toInvokeResult(jsonResult)

proc listLLMModels*(): Future[ModelsResponse] {.async.} =
  assertApiKey()

  let url =
    let raw = ENV.forgeApiUrl.strip()
    if raw.len > 0:
      raw.strip(chars = {'/'}, leading = false) & "/v1/models"
    else:
      ""

  let headers = newHttpHeaders({
    "authorization": "Bearer " & ENV.forgeApiKey
  })

  let response = await fetchWithBackoff(url, HttpGet, headers, "")

  if not isOk(response.status):
    raise newException(IOError, "List LLM models failed: " & $response.status & " – " & response.body)

  let jsonResult = parseJson(response.body)
  result.`object` = jsonResult.getOrDefault("object").getStr()
  result.data = @[]

  if jsonResult.hasKey("data") and jsonResult["data"].kind == JArray:
    for item in jsonResult["data"]:
      result.data.add(ModelInfo(
        id: item.getOrDefault("id").getStr(),
        `object`: item.getOrDefault("object").getStr(),
        created: item.getOrDefault("created").getBiggestInt(),
        owned_by: item.getOrDefault("owned_by").getStr()
      ))
